name: chess-1v1
description: Offline 2D local 1v1 chess game packaged as a Capacitor web project.

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),m={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.png':'image/png'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{const u=(q.url||'/').split('?')[0];let f=path.join(process.cwd(),'www',u==='/'?'index.html':u);if(!fs.existsSync(f)||fs.statSync(f).isDirectory())f=path.join(process.cwd(),'www','index.html');s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(s);}).listen(3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('Serving www on http://0.0.0.0:3000'));"
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm');const html=fs.readFileSync('www/index.html','utf8');const m=html.match(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);if(!m)process.exit(1);new vm.Script(m[1]);JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('www/manifest.json','utf8'));JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('capacitor.config.json','utf8'));console.log('Syntax and JSON validation passed.');"
